definitions.current: Each admitted current request own per-SSU V/C over admission-to-completion, including stalled spans; never exempted.
definitions.continuing: Vnext/Ccurrent for same-request internal layers and same-role next-request L0, over actual current compute window.
definitions.boundary: Only cross-role S-to-L or L-to-S next-request L0 Vnext/Ccurrent contributions. S/L are input read-length role labels, not native QoS SS/LL classes.
definitions.exception: Total reference may exceed capacity only while cross-role boundary contributions are present; continuing contribution alone must stay within capacity. No time interval is removed from current-demand check.
definitions.near: Fleet time at >=90% of total capacity, limited to 5% in each audit window by default; applies to current and continuing, not exempt boundary contributions. Per-SSU near-capacity time is reported but is not a hard rejection criterion; per-SSU peak <=40 remains mandatory.
definitions.lower_bound: max(max_s V_s/40,total V/50)-C, floored at zero, is an exclusive-transfer unavoidable stall lower bound; it omits small per-IO/control latencies.
definitions.causality: Stall above the exclusive lower bound is not proven FIFO loss. Temporal overlap of internal stalls and boundary IO/debt is correlation; same-input scheduler comparison or detailed IO trace is needed for causation.
definitions.debt: Vnext/Ccurrent ends at the deadline even if IO remains. Boundary overdue IO spans are retained separately; no reference is an all-interval scheduling feasibility proof.
definitions.full_run_utilization: Fixed fleet wall-time utilization includes draining tail idle; active_U excludes no-request idle. Warm all-NPU occupancy is checked explicitly.
definitions.cold: Initial L0 has no preceding compute window; included in current, physical traffic and utilization but no synthetic prefetch reference.
